value.text: SYNTHETIC stand-in text. Section 2 requires a landlord to give tenants 60 days of written notice before any rent increase above 5 percent. Section 3 makes the act take effect on 1 January 2027. Section 4 lets a tenant ask the housing office to review a notice that lacks the required period.
value.title: practice-case State A Assembly Bill 1201 (2026), Rent Notice Act
